description: The recursively defined cofinal sequence satisfies g(i)=max(f(i),sup_{j<i}(g(j)+1)).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Cofinality.cofinalSequence_equation.{u} (a : Ordinal.{u}) (f : a.cof.ord.ToType → Ordinal.{u})
  (i : a.cof.ord.ToType) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Cofinality.cofinalSequence a f i =
    max (f i) (⨆ j, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Cofinality.cofinalSequence a f ↑j + 1)
